coverage.note: The Magik*Magik Orchestra piece and the home-cooking street-vendor story name no street address.

findings.description: The only address hit in Mission Local's story about the city's pretrial program closing is a photo caption — "The Hall of Justice at 850 Bryant Street" — identifying the building shown in the accompanying photograph. The story is about a program closing, not about the building.

citation.label: Mission Local, "S.F.'s trailblazing pretrial program is closing. Its replacement isn't ready.," 22 September 2026

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 850 BRYANT ST → parcel 3759042; sf-parcels has blklot 3759042 active, 425–425 07TH; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use. The assessor files the parcel as 425 07TH ST.

publish.note: Photo caption, not reporting about the building. Fails the ten-year test: the story is about a pretrial-release program's closure, not a fact about the Hall of Justice.
